draw_on_first_hit.unit: +1 card drawn the first time you are hit each combat, per node

skill_damage_all.unit: +1 damage to all enemies per 4 Skills in a turn, per node

attack_strength.unit: +1 Strength per 4 Attacks in a turn, per node

attack_dexterity.unit: +1 Dexterity per 4 Attacks in a turn, per node

power_energy.unit: +1 Energy when you play a Power (once/turn), per node

skill_draw_chance.unit: +25% chance to draw 1 when you play a Skill, per node

exhaust_dodge.unit: +25% chance an exhausting card is discarded instead, per node
exhaust_dodge.hook: Harmony patch on CardCmd.Exhaust (no model hook)

ethereal_save.unit: an Ethereal card that would exhaust is discarded instead (on/off)
ethereal_save.hook: Harmony patch on CardCmd.Exhaust (no model hook)

kill_gold.unit: +3 gold per enemy killed, per node

kill_block.unit: +3 Block per enemy killed, per node

execute_bonus.unit: +25% damage to enemies at <= 20% HP, per node

hit_energy_chance.unit: +25% chance for +1 Energy on unblocked enemy damage, per node

spread_debuffs_on_kill.unit: on killing a Vulnerable enemy, its debuffs spread to another (on/off)

gain_amplify.unit: gain +1 more when you gain Strength/Dexterity (max 3/turn)
gain_amplify.note: Its old cost (a bundled enemy-rider curse) no longer exists; whether it needs a new one is a balance call, left to you.

loss_invert.unit: enemy Strength/Dexterity reduction becomes a gain (on/off)
loss_invert.note: Decided: strength and defense branch, with gain_amplify (both react to Strength/Dexterity changes).

energy_discharge.unit: +4 damage to all enemies per bonus Energy gained, per node
energy_discharge.hook: Harmony patch on PlayerCmd.GainEnergy (AfterModifyingEnergyGain has no arguments)
energy_discharge.note: Decided: Gamble branch, as the payoff for the energy keystones. energy_for_hp and energy_for_max_hp grant bonus Energy every turn, which triggers this each turn; it also works with any other bonus Energy, so it is never dead weight.

energy_for_hp.unit: +1 Energy per turn, lose 5 HP at combat start

energy_for_max_hp.unit: +1 Energy per turn, lose 1 Max HP permanently each combat start
energy_for_max_hp.note: Keystone. The permanent Max HP loss recurs every combat in a run; check the totals before keeping it.

replay_grant.unit: each turn a random hand card gains Replay 1; playing it costs Vulnerable 1 + Frail 1

enemy_strip.unit: each turn move one enemy power 1 toward zero
enemy_strip.note: Keystone (decided). Strips enemy buffs AND teammates' debuffs on enemies; a gamble by design.

symmetric_vulnerable.unit: Vulnerable 1 to one enemy and to yourself at combat start, per node
symmetric_vulnerable.note: Decided: owner-only. The old code picked a random player from the whole party; now it is you (identical in solo).

symmetric_weak.unit: Weak 1 to one enemy and to yourself at combat start, per node

random_debuff.unit: each turn 50%: Vulnerable/Weak/Frail 1 to a random enemy or to yourself, per node
random_debuff.note: Decided: owner-only. The old code could pick any player in the party.

gold_armor.unit: enemy hits deal 1 less, costing 5 gold each time

proc_double.unit: other perks' random procs happen twice as often
proc_double.note: Old text says relic prefixes and curses; reword to perks. Needs the PerkProc plumbing. Stacking: multiplier = 1 + total.

proc_boost.unit: +10 points to other perks' random proc chances
proc_boost.note: Reword relics -> perks. Needs the PerkProc plumbing.

proc_reroll.unit: other perks' random procs get a second roll
proc_reroll.note: Reword relics -> perks. Needs the PerkProc plumbing.

start_power_boost.note: Reword relics -> perks; depends on start_artifact/buffer/blur.

potion_double.unit: your potion-use perk effects are doubled
potion_double.note: Reword; depends on the potion_* effects.

potion_boost.note: Reword; depends on the potion_* effects.

potion_strength.unit: +1 Strength on potion use, per node

potion_dexterity.unit: +1 Dexterity on potion use, per node

curse_draw_stat.unit: drawing a Curse card gives +1 Strength or Dexterity (once/turn), per node

block_per_relic.unit: +2 Block per relic carried at combat start (max 8), per node
block_per_relic.note: Old Attuned counted OTHER FORGED relics; now counts relics carried.

curse_count_ramp.unit: combat-start ramp by number of Curse cards in your deck (1: +1 Str; 2: +1 Str +1 Dex; 3: +2/+2; 4: +3/+2; 5+: +3/+3 and Intangible 1), once per node
curse_count_ramp.hook: AfterRoomEntered (room is CombatRoom) + PowerCmd.Apply; count Player.Deck cards with Type == Curse
curse_count_ramp.note: Decided: count Curse cards in the deck (the old code counted Relic Forge curses on relics). Combat-created curses do not count; the deck is the run deck.

vulnerable_resist.unit: Vulnerable is 0.10 (10 points) less effective on you, per node: +50% damage taken becomes +40%
vulnerable_resist.hook: Harmony postfix on VulnerablePower.ModifyDamageMultiplicative (game hardcodes its modifiers; no model hook)
vulnerable_resist.note: Applied last, to the game's final multiplier, so Debilitate etc. still count (a stacked-resistance player is not flatly immune to them). Floors at neutral. Natural cap = the vanilla size; the UI must read it from the power. Place past the cost nodes so the player pays first.

weak_resist.unit: Weak is 0.10 (10 points) less effective on you, per node: -25% damage dealt becomes -15%
weak_resist.hook: Harmony postfix on WeakPower.ModifyDamageMultiplicative (game hardcodes its modifiers; no model hook)
weak_resist.note: Same rules as vulnerable_resist. Base value 0.75 (read from the game's IL). Weak is a smaller effect than Vulnerable (1.5), so the same 10 points is a larger share of it; per-node size is yours to tune.

frail_resist.unit: Frail is 0.10 (10 points) less effective on you, per node: -25% block gained becomes -15%
frail_resist.hook: Harmony postfix on FrailPower.ModifyBlockMultiplicative (game hardcodes its modifiers; no model hook)
frail_resist.note: Same rules as vulnerable_resist. Base value 0.75 (read from the game's IL).

vigor_strength_pct.unit: each Vigor consumed: +15% chance of 1 Strength, per node
